Subject: VAT qualification and debit note for Redwood EU billing

Hi Rafael / Marissa —

Thanks for the call earlier. To wrap up our EU billing transition we need to confirm two items from Redwood before we can switch to reverse-charge for Klarity invoices: 1) Redwood confirms the EU entity receiving invoices (billing entity) and 2) acceptance of a debit note that moves the outstanding balance to that EU entity (Klarity requires this for our accounting).

Attached is our seller self-cert (klarity_seller_vat_selfcert.xlsx). Our accounting team has asked for:
- confirmation of Redwood EU billing entity (legal name and VAT ID)
- copy of the debit note draft so we can confirm acceptance internally
- cutover payment date suggestions (we are trying to hit month-end Nov 30)

We are hoping to avoid cash-hold or split payments; if the debit note can be issued and accepted by Nov 26 we can move the payment to the EU clearing account on Nov 30. Can you confirm process and any outstanding evidence needed from our side?

Thanks,
Sofia Kline
Head of Revenue Ops — Klarity
sofia.k@klarity.ai

Attachments (2): klarity_seller_vat_selfcert.xlsx (spreadsheet, 46 KB), bank_details.csv (csv, 2 KB)

From: rafael_mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>

Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 14:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: VAT qualification and debit note for Redwood EU billing

Sofia — thanks for the clear note and the attachment. We ran an initial check against VIES and need two quick confirmations before we generate the debit note:

1) Billing entity: Redwood Inference Ltd (RED-EU-03) — VAT ID: GB999999973 (this is the EU-facing entity we use for EU reverse-charge flows). Please confirm this is the entity Klarity will accept on the debit note.

2) VAT ID validation: we validated your VAT number against VIES but need a signed seller self-cert (we received the spreadsheet, thank you) AND confirmation of the company registration number on your side (for our internal audit). If you can add that to the seller_selfcert tab we can close validation.

Next steps from our side:
- Finance will produce a draft debit note (attached) that reallocates the outstanding amount from our US ledger to RED-EU-03.
- Once Klarity countersigns the debit note, we will post the payable to the EU ledger and issue a final invoice showing reverse-charge treatment.
- Proposed payment cutover: Nov 30, 2026. To hit that date we need counter-signature by EOD Nov 26.

I attached a draft for review: draft_debit_note_RED-EU-03.pdf (note: it is a transfer of liability, not a refund). Also attaching a CSV with our suggested payment-routing instructions for the EU clearing account.

If Klarity needs a different legal name or VAT on the debit note, flag asap — changes after issuance are a pain for both sides.

Rafael Mendes
Finance — Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Attachments (2): draft_debit_note_RED-EU-03.pdf (pdf, 28 KB), payment_cutover_instructions.csv (csv, 3 KB)
